## Purpose
Keeps caches, the local `.env`, the databases and the generated tool modules out of the Tool Service image build context.

## Settings that matter
The excluded entries are `__pycache__`, `*.pyc`, `*.pyo`, `.env`, `db/`, `*.db`, `dynamic_tools/`, `.git` and `.venv`.

## Read by
Docker, when building `tool-service/Dockerfile`.

## Environment-specific differences
None.

## Nuances and gotchas
- **`dynamic_tools/` is excluded, so the image starts with no generated modules.** The volumes hold them, and the native tools are re-seeded on start.
- **This also drops `dynamic_tools/__init__.py`.** The Dockerfile recreates the directory with `mkdir`.

## How to rebuild this file
List the patterns above.
